Nina and Ben had great fun there. Ben's birthday is in November. Ben is interested in reading. She topped the chocolate mousse with fresh raspberries.
Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school garden by bike. The tea grower picks leaves at dawn.
They took many photos at the classroom. The weather was rainy that day. Both of them like soup and water. Best of all, a large dog sat by the gate.
The school garden is one of the best places in the city. Nina spent the weekend at the supermarket. Nina is reading a book about history.
